decisive_items: Biopsy of the glans penis ulcer showed dermal infiltrate of atypical lymphocytes, which were CD20+, CD79a+, and CD5+
PCR analysis revealed a clonal IgH gene rearrangement
response.rationale: Atypical lymphocytes with CD20/CD79a positivity and clonal IgH rearrangement indicate a B-cell lymphoma, not a T-cell lymphoma.

rejected.why: Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma is contradicted by B-cell markers CD20+ and CD79a+ as well as clonal IgH rearrangement; the reactive T-cell infiltrate is only a background finding.
